policy.attempts: One attempt per cell, including failures and interrupted attempts; no silent reruns
policy.comparison: Every strategy uses the same movement optimizer, movement freedoms, feasibility limits and force allocation; only probing adaptation differs
policy.success: Only actual body-and-foot progress is SUCCESS; SAFE_STOP and RECOVERED_STOP do not count as task completion
policy.truth: Hidden pad strength is evaluator-only; sensing, geometry and error bounds are public
policy.interpretation: Predeclared engineering cases and declared seeds, not a statistical population or independent samples within each trace
policy.holdout: Held-out labels describe condition selection before evaluation; development conditions remain labeled separately
